entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 10.0.20 breaks implicit styles #33203
  • Android emulators only showing when VS26 runs as admin (Windows 11) #33202
  • [iOS/Mac] CollectionView2 EmptyView takes up large horizontal space even when the content is small #33201
  • MediaPicker.CapturePhotoAsync crashes after taking too long to capture photo #33200
  • [iOS] Shell NavBarIsVisible is not updated when changing ShellContent #33191
  • Safe area layout supporting for NavigationPage and TabbedPage #33190
  • MediaPicker - RotateImage not working #33189
  • Very slow debugging on Android phone. #33188

Closed

  • [iOS] Modal-Page crashes #31829
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • Rounded corners on MAUI Shell Flyout menu on Windows. #15060
  • [X] Xaml sourcegen #30489
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • SwipeView Closes when Content Changes even with SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked="RemainOpen" (iOS only) #32033
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • Android WebView is recreated on background/resume even when Activity and Page are alive #33184
  • NavigationBar of AndroidSpecific Color proprerty is not working on Android 16 #33193

Created

  • Map Azure DevOps variables to MSBuild environment format for version metadata #33199
